name: Kneeling Leg Curl
steps: Kneel on the support with your nonworking leg and rest your forearms on the machine.
Align your working knee with the pivot and set the roller against your lower calf just above the heel.
Curl your working heel smoothly up toward your glute by contracting your hamstring.
Lower the lever arm slowly back to near full extension, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your hips pressed steadily into the front pad instead of arching your lower back as you curl.
Pause briefly at peak contraction and control the descent without letting the stack slam.
